Each week is one completed Sunday–Saturday week. An award appears once, in the week of its NIH award-notice date, so amounts are never double-counted; every Monday the last 8 weeks are checked again, so awards NIH posts late are still added. Cards with several awards list each one and end with a ruled = total. “No department listed” (-- in the table) means NIH reported none for that keyword-matched award. PI lines show the contact PI of the largest award; emails come from the PI’s own recent publications (PubMed and Europe PMC), and -- means none was found yet. Source: NIH RePORTER (refreshes Sunday nights; this page updates every Monday morning).
